detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Spellcraft & Wizardry is a major expansion bringing the wizard fantasy to RAIDBORN. Master powerful magic, ascend the ranks of wizardry, explore the Academy of Spellstone, and uncover the dark secrets lurking within.









Unleash devastating destruction bolts, cast dark necromancy spells, and enhance yourself with arcane support magic. Become a master wizard, necromancer, battle mage, or anything in between.

  • Satisfying magic system
  • Complete wizard skill tree
  • Scroll crafting for battle mages
  • Wizard rank progression





Explore the ancient Academy of Spellstone, begin your journey as a humble novice, and follow the path to true wizardry. Experience life at the academy, ascend the ranks of wizardry, and uncover the dark secrets lurking within.

  • Handcrafted wizard academy
  • Fully voiced main quest
  • Wizard-themed side quests
  • New wizard items
